description: Write a pandas ETL script for ecom_market that flattens nested order JSON documents into a line-item table. Each order has a nested customer object and an items array. The script should: (1) explode items to one row per line with a 1-based line_no, (2) extract customer.contact.email (may be missing at any level), (3) compute line_total = qty * unit_price rounded to 2 decimals, (4) keep order-level shipping_fee on line 1 only so that summing the column does not multiply it, (5) write orders with an empty or missing items array to a separate orders_without_items output.
edge_cases: o2 has an empty items array: it must appear in orders_without_items, not vanish in the explode
o3 has no customer.contact key: customer_email is null and the script must not raise KeyError
Repeating shipping_fee on every line inflates total shipping (4.99 would be counted twice for o1)
3 * 1.2 is 3.5999999999999996 in binary floating point; line_total must be rounded to 3.6
common_failure_modes: FM3: Order-level fee repeated on each exploded line, inflating aggregates
FM1: explode / json_normalize silently drops orders with empty arrays
FM5: Missing nested keys raise or misalign columns
